notes: The table is an image inside the PDF (pdftotext gives only its title); it was read on the page rendered with pdftoppm. The table's notes: 'Data for population, production and procurement are official statistics. Rows (1) and (6) report production revised by the authors using archival data (see text). Row (7) reports official production figures. Rows (8)-(9) report production revised by Davis and Wheatcroft (2004) (see their Table 1).' 'Davis' is a misprint for Davies (R. W. Davies and S. G. Wheatcroft, The Years of Hunger, 2004). The years are harvest years as printed (1927, 1928, ..., 1933, 1937, 1939). The ratios of procurement to production in the chapter are the book's calculation.
